+```java
+@Test void bulkDiscountThreshold_below() {
+    assertEquals(9_999, calculator.calculateTotalCents(new Order(List.of(new Item(9_999)))));
+}
+```
+- **Tests**: Subtotal 1 cent below threshold
+- **Input**: 9,999 cents
+- **Expected Output**: 9,999 cents (no discount)
+- **Verifies**: Discount not applied below 10,000 cent threshold
+
+**Test 2: `bulkDiscountThreshold_exact()` (Lines 26-28)**
+```java
+@Test void bulkDiscountThreshold_exact() {
+    assertEquals(9_000, calculator.calculateTotalCents(new Order(List.of(new Item(10_000)))));
+}
+```
+- **Tests**: Subtotal exactly at threshold
+- **Input**: 10,000 cents
+- **Expected Output**: 9,000 cents (10% discount applied)
+- **Verifies**: Discount applied exactly at 10,000 cent threshold
+
+**Test 3: `bulkDiscountThreshold_above()` (Lines 30-32)**
+```java
+@Test void bulkDiscountThreshold_above() {
+    assertEquals(9_001, calculator.calculateTotalCents(new Order(List.of(new Item(10_001)))));
+}
+```
+- **Tests**: Subtotal 1 cent above threshold
+- **Input**: 10,001 cents
+- **Expected Output**: 9,001 cents (10% discount applied, Math.round(10,001 × 0.9) = 9,001)
+- **Verifies**: Discount applied above 10,000 cent threshold with correct rounding
+
+---
+
+## Threshold Logic Verification
+
+### DiscountPolicy.discountRate() Implementation (Line 6-10)
+```java
+public static double discountRate(int subtotalCents, CustomerTier customerTier) {
+    if (customerTier == CustomerTier.VIP) return 0.20;
+    if (subtotalCents >= 10_000) return 0.10;
+    return 0.0;
+}
+```
+
+**Key Logic**: 
+- Line 8: `if (subtotalCents >= 10_000)` → threshold is inclusive (≥ 10,000)
+- Tests verify this boundary: 9,999 (below) vs 10,000+ (at/above)
+
+### PricingCalculator.calculateTotalCents() Implementation (Line 4-9)
+```java
+public int calculateTotalCents(Order order) {
+    int subtotalCents = order.items().stream()
+            .mapToInt(item -> item.priceCents() * item.quantity()).sum();
+    double discountRate = DiscountPolicy.discountRate(subtotalCents, order.customerTier());
+    return (int) Math.round(subtotalCents * (1 - discountRate));
+}
+```
+
+**Key Logic**:
+- Line 5-6: Calculates subtotal as sum of price × quantity
+- Line 8: Applies discount with rounding: `Math.round(subtotalCents * (1 - discountRate))`
+- Test 3 verifies rounding: 10,001 × 0.9 = 9,000.9 → rounds to 9,001
+
+---
+

+
+✅ **JUnit 5 Framework**
+- Import: `import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;`
+- Annotation: `@Test` on each test method
+- Assertions: `static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals`
+

+- Method naming: `testScenarioDescription()` format
+- Test construction: `new Order(List.of(new Item(...)))`

+1. Subtotal = 9,999 cents

+   - Not VIP (tier is REGULAR)
+   - 9_999 < 10_000, so bulk discount NOT applied
+   - Returns 0.0
+3. Final Total = 9_999 × (1 - 0.0) = 9_999

+
+**Expected Result**: ✅ PASS

+}
+```
+
+**Input**: Single item priced at exactly 10,000 cents
+- `new Item(10_000)` creates item with priceCents=10,000, quantity=1
+- Order constructed with `new Order(List.of(...))` uses default REGULAR tier
+
+**Calculation**:
+1. Subtotal = 10,000 cents
+2. Discount Rate = `DiscountPolicy.discountRate(10_000, REGULAR)`
+   - Not VIP (tier is REGULAR)
+   - 10_000 >= 10_000, so bulk discount IS applied
+   - Returns 0.10
+3. Final Total = Math.round(10_000 × (1 - 0.10)) = Math.round(10_000 × 0.90) = Math.round(9_000.0) = 9_000
+4. Assertion: `assertEquals(9_000, ...)`
+
+**Expected Result**: ✅ PASS
+
+---
+
+#### Test 3: `bulkDiscountThreshold_above()` (Line 30-32)
+**Purpose**: Verify 10% bulk discount is applied when subtotal is 1 cent above threshold
+
+```java
+@Test void bulkDiscountThreshold_above() {
+    assertEquals(9_001, calculator.calculateTotalCents(new Order(List.of(new Item(10_001)))));
+}
